lines.en: Roars as it stomps forward.
Swishes its tail, growling low.

lines.zh: 在地面上留下深长的足迹。
lines.en: Leaves deep footprints in the ground.
Muscles tense as it moves slowly.
Moves heavily across the ground.

lines.zh: 转动巨大身躯，缓缓行进。
lines.en: Turns its massive bulk, moving slowly.
Heels stomp, moving like a mountain.
Slow but firm in its walk.
Swishes its tail, searching for prey.
Great claws scoop up the dirt.

lines.zh: 它的脚掌压碎枯木，声音很闷。
lines.en: Its foot crushes dead wood with a dull crack.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过后，灌木全倒了。
lines.en: After its tail sweeps by, the brush is all down.

lines.zh: 它一边走，一边嗅着你的方向。
lines.en: It walks and sniffs toward you as it goes.

lines.zh: 它绕过巨石，不愿多费力气。
lines.en: It goes around the boulder, unwilling to waste effort.
Stands quietly, eyes watching.
Stretches its forelegs, relaxing slowly.
Rumbles a deep growl.
Looks up at the sky, seemingly in thought.
Stands on its hind legs, swishing its tail.
Bends down to seek out its prey on the ground.

lines.zh: 我蹲在岩下，牙齿轻轻相碰。
lines.en: Crouched under the rock, I click my teeth softly.
Sniffs the air with its nose.
Turns its head, scanning its surroundings.
Licks its teeth gently.

lines.zh: 它把下巴搁在枯树干上磨。
lines.en: It rests its jaw on a dead trunk and rubs.

lines.zh: 它张开嘴散热，牙齿一排排。
lines.en: It opens its mouth to cool off, teeth in rows.
It stares at the egg in the incubator.

lines.zh: 它用爪子刨开泥土，闻了闻。
lines.en: It scrapes the dirt open and sniffs.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，目光凶光四射。
lines.en: Locks eyes on the player, with a fierce glare.
I am not angry yet. Do not run.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出警告的咆哮。
lines.en: Glares at the player, a warning roar.
Stares at the player, claws tensed.
Fierce eyes locked on the player.

lines.zh: 凝视玩家，发出威胁的低吼。
lines.en: Glares at the player, a threatening growl.

lines.zh: 注意到了玩家，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Notices the player, hissing softly.
Fixes its gaze on the player, muscles tensed.
Eyes glint, fixated on the player.
Glares at the player, showing its fangs.

lines.zh: 它低下头，正好与你平视。
lines.en: It lowers its head until it is level with you.

lines.zh: 它把你和周围的小兽比了比。
lines.en: It sizes you up against the smaller beasts nearby.
Spine injury, moving slowly.
Leg injury, limping.
Abdomen injury, painful howl.
Wings injured, limited flight.
Tail injured, cannot swing.
Claws injured, weaker attacks.
Head injury, slow movement.
Neck injury, difficulty breathing.
Bone dust got in my eye.
Severe pain, limited mobility.

lines.zh: 闻到鲜肉香气，你都动心了？
lines.en: Smell the fresh flesh, you're tempted?

lines.zh: 靠近我，你不会有好下场。
lines.en: Come closer, and you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 你这小东西，也敢来挑逗我？
lines.en: You dare to provoke me, little one?

lines.zh: 我的牙齿比任何剑都锋利。
lines.en: My teeth are sharper than any sword.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，让我前爪扒开土。
lines.en: The meat in your hand makes my foreclaws rake the dirt.
You have no idea how powerful I am.

lines.zh: 你那点食物根本不够塞牙缝。
lines.en: Your food is not enough to fill a tooth.

lines.zh: 你的肉还不够我塞牙缝。
lines.en: Your flesh isn't enough to fill my teeth.

lines.zh: 别想靠近我，否则后悔莫及。
lines.en: Don't come too close, or you'll regret it.
I'm the T-Rex, you know what that means.
The ground shakes, I'm here.

lines.zh: 你挡在我面前，很不聪明。
lines.en: You're in my way, that's not smart.

lines.zh: 你挡在面前，我的尾巴先扫过去。
lines.en: You block my path; my tail swings first.
I'll speak to the earth with my feet.
Your shield can't stop me.
One stomp and you'll be weakened.

lines.zh: 我的爪子可以撕裂一切。
lines.en: My claws can tear through anything.
I stomp to warn you.
Don't block my path, or you'll regret it.
I only need one step.

lines.zh: 靠近些，我的鼻息吹动你的头发。
lines.en: Come closer; my breath stirs your hair.
Come, let's spend a lifetime together.
Can't you smell my presence?
I'm the T-Rex, you're mine.

lines.zh: 我的后代会继承我的力量。
lines.en: My offspring will inherit my strength.
These teeth are only to guard you.
We are destined for each other.
My strength can protect you.

lines.zh: 我在你身边踏地，低声震动喉咙。
lines.en: I stamp beside you and rumble deep in my throat.
I'm your only home.
Fossil shines brightly.
This was your home.
Secrets lie here.
Beware my sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 鳞片闪烁着历史的痕迹。
lines.en: Scales bear history's marks.
My power comes from here.
This fossil proves my existence.
My existence testifies history.
My past lies here.

lines.zh: 这化石记录着我的故事。
lines.en: This fossil tells my tale.

lines.zh: 怒吼冲出胸腔，树上的鸟全飞了。
lines.en: A roar bursts from my chest; the birds all scatter.
You've trespassed my domain.
My anger is ignited.
Ignore me at your peril.
You've crossed my line.
One stomp and your knees go weak.
Prepare for my roar.
You threaten my survival.

lines.zh: 你打疼我了，现在换我咬。
lines.en: You hurt me. Now it is my turn to bite.

lines.zh: 你激起了我的攻击欲望。
lines.en: You've aroused my aggression.

lines.zh: 你打它的那一下，它记着。
lines.en: It remembers the hit you landed.
It was calm until you raised your hand.

lines.zh: 它把巢里的蛋挡在身后。
lines.en: It puts its body between you and the eggs.

lines.zh: 它选中你，作为要踏的东西。
lines.en: It chooses you as the thing to trample.

lines.zh: 我一踏地，你的膝盖就软。
lines.en: One stomp of mine weakens your knees.

lines.zh: 地面随我的脚步发抖，你跑不远的。
lines.en: The ground shakes with my steps. You won't get far.
Your movements are noted.
I will remember you.
You are my prey.
My gaze is on you.
One stomp and your legs go weak.
I will end your life.
The ground shakes under me.
You are within my range.

lines.zh: 它抬起前爪，影子罩住你。
lines.en: It lifts a foreleg and its shadow covers you.
It digs in its hind legs and soil curls up.
Before the jaws open, the throat rumbles.
Its tail begins to swing side to side.

lines.zh: 它把重量压在前脚掌上。
lines.en: It shifts its weight onto its front feet.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，巨大身影逼近！
lines.en: Rumble deep, massive form closing in!

lines.zh: 利爪抓破地面，你感受到了吗？
lines.en: Claws tear the earth, can you feel it?

lines.zh: 强健后腿一蹬，大地颤抖！
lines.en: Powerful hind legs kick, the earth shakes!

lines.zh: 巨大尾巴扫过，你被远远击退！
lines.en: Tail sweep strong, you are pushed back!
Bite through prey, leaving only scraps!

lines.zh: 残破盾牌在它的巨口中破碎！
lines.en: Weak shield crumbles in its mouth!
Weakness brings it down, survival urge flares!

lines.zh: 用法杖轻轻触碰，它会苏醒！
lines.en: Stroke with wand, and it awakens!

lines.zh: 鳞片与牙齿，珍贵战利品！
lines.en: Scales and teeth, valuable spoils!

lines.zh: 装饰法杖，治愈它的虚弱！
lines.en: Wand of adornment, heals its weakness!

lines.zh: 一踏落地，你的膝盖发软。
lines.en: One stomp lands and your knees go weak.

lines.zh: 尾扫过来，你被甩出几步。
lines.en: The tail sweeps and throws you a few paces.

lines.zh: 它咬住你的盾，连人带盾甩开。
lines.en: It bites your shield and flings shield and you aside.

lines.zh: 它的牙合上，空气被挤出一声闷响。
lines.en: Its teeth close, and the air pops with the force.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的阴影再次降临！
lines.en: Cretaceous shadow falls once more!

lines.zh: 从岩石中缓缓走出，霸王龙！
lines.en: Emerging from stone, Tyrannosaurus Rex!

lines.zh: 在古老的森林中静静等待！
lines.en: Patience in ancient forest waits!

lines.zh: 猎物的嘶鸣声吸引了它！
lines.en: Prey's cry draws its attention!

lines.zh: 寂静的黄昏，它的狩猎时刻！
lines.en: Silent dusk, its hunting time!
Morning light, it sneaks in!

lines.zh: 巢穴中孵化，新生霸王龙！
lines.en: Hatchling emerges, newborn T-Rex!

lines.zh: 它在岩层中埋伏，静候猎物！
lines.en: It lies in wait, rock layers hold!

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，它的咆哮回荡！
lines.en: Night falls, its roar resounds!

lines.zh: 地壳运动，带来它的重生！
lines.en: Tectonic shift, its rebirth!

lines.zh: 化石里的DNA，终于长成了它。
lines.en: The DNA in the fossil has finally grown into it.

lines.zh: 培育器打开，它迈出第一步。
lines.en: The cultivator opens and it takes a first step.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，露出的是一口牙。
lines.en: The shell splits, and what shows is teeth.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的脚步声，压过现代的林。
lines.en: Cretaceous footsteps drown out a modern forest.

lines.zh: 它从黏液的雾气里站起来。
lines.en: It stands up out of the ooze's mist.
The earth of the nest is pushed aside.

lines.zh: 复活完成，它先叫了一声。
lines.en: The revival finishes, and its first act is a roar.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅这片陌生的空气。
lines.en: It sniffs this unfamiliar air.
Burned by fire, painful scream.
Fell, crawling to move.
Drowned, struggling to swim.
Explosion shock, colliding around.
Arrow pierced, struggling down.
Magic corruption, weak and falling.
Starving, weak and stagger.
Struck by lightning, painful scream.
Fall into void, painful scream.
